row.notes: Copies the graph config (driver id at self+0x38, season index +0x3c, flags +0x40..+0x45, four refcounted strings +0x48..+0x60, min/max weekend counts +0x68/+0x6c) then rebuilds the contract-hub driver ratings graph. Resolves season (self+0x2c0 ptr, +0x2c8 index) from career+0x1030, computes current overall rating (Career_Get_DriverOverallRating, averaged over both drivers in online two-player career) and offer range (Game_DriverContracts_ComputeOfferRange) into bound props and self+0x2d4/+0x2d8; weekend count self+0x2cc and offset +0x2d0 from season calendar +0x288..+0x290 (event state +0x23c: 2 = completed). Builds the X axis with one entry per weekend (props name, texture_override from #overrides.tracks.flags_rectangle_small.%s, weekend_pip_texture_override #overrides.icons.driver_rating_weekend_pip.past/current/future, weekend_state completed/in_progress_or_next_weekend/not_started), Y axis min/max at self+0/+4 rounded outward to step self+8 (default 0..100), then fills series lines from the vector self+0x2a8..+0x2b0 (0x28-byte entries, float samples at +0x10..+0x18) with styles graph_line_ratings, graph_line_ratings_projection, graph_line_dotted_ratings_green, graph_line_dotted_ratings_retain and driver_ratings_graph_pip markers. Hook here to change what the ratings graph plots.
